controls.positive: No people. Hand-painted anime film background of a rain-soaked arcade entrance on a narrow street at night; at the right edge a glowing vending machine beside the entrance. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain dark graphite wall, softly lit, almost empty and low in detail. Faint rose and cyan reflections on the wet surfaces, muted graphite palette with small amber accents. Nobody in the picture. Fixed eye-level camera, calm and quiet, hand-painted cel anime film background art. No text, no signs, no logos, no characters, no people, no figures.
